subject: Pre-register the mixed-class comparison for the IM-023 evaluation
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-06, during the IM-023 full runs and before any evaluation result, to pre-register whether the two mixed forest classes, barrblandskog (28) and blandskog (4), are meaningful classes at 10 m pixels or are better derived from the fraction head's species shares; 'testa blandskog samtidigt'. Scope: one new item under the evaluation step of docs/experiments/class-separability/retrain_barrblandskog.md that fixes the truth (NFI species volumes; sealed truth v1 unchanged), the predictors, the metrics and the decision rule in advance. No code, no scoring; scoring against the sealed holdout still needs Tobias's go. Review: Codex.
